integrity_statement: The stated all-order asymptotic follows analytically from the interpolation integrals; numerical checks are supplementary. Historical comparisons were performed against material actually inspected, not claimed exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: The negative quadratic form is an algebraic energy obstruction, not evidence of instability along a PDE solution trajectory.
The result does not determine a sharp positive mesh-ratio threshold or assert uniformity in the fractional order near its endpoints.
Historical priority remains open to previously unindexed counterexamples.
title: Three-step unbounded energy indefiniteness for nonuniform Alikhanov fractional differentiation
